constraints: formula may be either a formula object created by Formula/Formula from string, or a plain object with a required 'formula' property (the formula object) and an optional 'name' property (Text) used as the displayed label instead of the formula reference.
rangeUpdate is only honored when targetObj is a range; it is ignored if targetObj is an element or document.
The formula object is evaluated within the execution context (database/component) that created it, not necessarily the context in which it is later displayed.
